title: Pirates' Fortune
prompt:

Continue the moonlit cove, water and rocks naturally around them; preserve ship, moon, palms, colours, lighting, materials and illustration style. initialGenerationPrompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: original premium illustrated slot catalogue title card.
Primary request: one beautiful finished Pirates' Fortune title card preserving its moonlit tropical cove and Doubloon Purse treasure identity.
Scene/backdrop: a calm deep-blue tropical cove at night, a soft moon reflection on teal water, rocky island silhouettes and a few dark palm fronds framing outer corners. A black-sailed wooden pirate ship with warm amber cabin lanterns sits in the middle distance.
Subject: a rich brown leather doubloon purse with stitched edges, red drawstrings and gold tips, a few embossed compass-star gold doubloons peeking from its open mouth. Beside it, a small wooden treasure chest with restrained gold hardware and a few ruby, sapphire, emerald and amber gems; no gigantic money pile. The purse is the foreground focal prop; ship is atmospheric, not a second dominant subject.
Style/medium: premium professionally illustrated adventure-game key art, painterly but polished and detailed, controlled highlights and depth, crisp silhouettes. Deep navy, turquoise seawater, weathered brown leather/wood, warm amber and antique gold.
Composition/framing: TRUE wide 2:1 landscape. Foreground purse/chest group balances the large title on the opposite side, with the ship sitting behind in the cove. Title remains on quiet dark sky/water. Keep entire title and essential purse/chest subjects inside x=15%–85%, y=20%–80%, and give them generous surrounding breathing room; central 80% width / 70% height must contain all essential details. No title/object overlap. Strong readability at 256x128.
Text (verbatim): "Pirates' Fortune". Exactly these words once, TWO lines: "Pirates'" above "Fortune". The apostrophe comes AFTER the s in Pirates'. Large substantial weathered gold serif display lettering, restrained bevel and dark shadow.
Constraints: no human characters, no new cultural/religious motifs, no extra wording or slogans, payouts, slot reels, spin buttons, fake UI, brands, logos or watermark. Opaque background. One image only.
